statutoryBasis: Health Products Act 2007; Health Products (Therapeutic Products) Regulations 2016; PIC/S Guide to Good Manufacturing Practice for Medicinal Products (PE 009-17); Singapore Standard SS 585:2013
provenance: Health Sciences Authority (HSA) Singapore Auditing & Licensing Division; PIC/S Secretariat; Enterprise Singapore (SS 585)

PICS_GMP.title: Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS) & Management Review
PICS_GMP.criteria: Senior management periodic review, formal CAPA system, and risk-based change control

PICS_GMP.title: Personnel & Qualified Person (QP) / Responsible Person (RP)
PICS_GMP.criteria: Qualified Person registered with HSA, certified release authority, and adequate technical training

PICS_GMP.title: Premises, HVAC & Environmental Differential Pressure
PICS_GMP.criteria: HVAC qualification, positive differential pressure cascade (min 10-15 Pa), and HEPA filter integrity (DOP/PAO test)

PICS_GMP.title: Documentation, Batch Records & Data Integrity (ALCOA+)
PICS_GMP.criteria: Batch manufacturing/packaging record review, contemporaneous audit trails, and 5-year retention past expiry

PICS_GMP.title: Production & Cross-Contamination Prevention (Health-Based Limits)
PICS_GMP.criteria: Toxicological assessment (PDE / ADE), dedicated facilities for sensitising materials, and validated cleaning limits

PICS_GMP.title: Quality Control & Analytical Method Validation (ICH Q2)
PICS_GMP.criteria: CoA verification, reference standard management, stability testing under Zone IVb tropical conditions (30°C/75% RH)

PICS_GMP.title: Complaints, Product Defects & Mandatory HSA Recall
PICS_GMP.criteria: SOP for defect triage, mock recall executed annually, and 24-hour statutory notification to HSA for Class 1 defects

SS585_GDP.title: Quality Management & Cold Chain Integrity SOPs
SS585_GDP.criteria: Documented quality system, temperature excursion reporting protocol, and qualified secondary packaging validation

SS585_GDP.title: Responsible Person & Cold Chain Staff Competence
SS585_GDP.criteria: Designated RP with pharmaceutical or biomedical logistics qualifications and GDP training records

SS585_GDP.title: Warehouse Temperature Mapping & Alarm Systems
SS585_GDP.criteria: Seasonal 3-dimensional thermal mapping (summer/monsoon), calibrated sensors (±0.5°C), and 24/7 automated SMS alert

SS585_GDP.title: Refrigerated Transport Validation & Datalogger Placement
SS585_GDP.criteria: Active refrigerated reefers or qualified passive shippers (PCM), worst-case tarmac transit mapping at Changi Airport

SS585_GDP.title: Traceability, Anti-Counterfeiting & Tamper Evidence
SS585_GDP.criteria: Batch serialisation verification, sealed tamper-evident containers, and audit log reconciliation across SingHealth/NHG/NUHS deliveries
